name: todo-api
description: Single backend for the todo list: creates, lists (oldest first), updates the title or done state of, and deletes todos, validating titles (trimmed, 1-200 characters). It owns the PostgreSQL store and is the only component that touches it. It is open to anyone, with no sign-in, and does not model users, sharing, due dates or categories.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores the todos: title, done state and creation time.
